name: galaxy
description: Galaxy Nova and Orbit desktop workspace

scripts.build: npm run build:nova && npm run build:orbit && npm run build:portal
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @galaxy/nova-webview && npm run lint --workspace @galaxy/orbit-webview && npm run lint --workspace @galaxy/portal
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @galaxy/nova-webview && npm run typecheck --workspace @galaxy/orbit-webview && npm run typecheck --workspace @galaxy/nova-electron && npm run typecheck --workspace @galaxy/orbit-electron && npm run typecheck --workspace @galaxy/ai-bridge-native && npm run typecheck --workspace ai-bridge && npm run typecheck --workspace @galaxy/portal
scripts.build:electron: node scripts/build-electron.cjs nova && node scripts/build-electron.cjs orbit
scripts.test:bridge: npm run test --workspace @galaxy/ai-bridge-native && npm run test --workspace ai-bridge
